name: numeric_from_A_predicted_points
adaptive_rule: Use the exact first-response normalized points from the two dependencies; skip without a request if either is null or invalid.
prompt_template: TARGET T={A_button_point}; REFERENCE P={A_tip_point}; coordinates x right, y down. Compare TARGET relative to REFERENCE in the image plane. Output only vertical and horizontal relations.
prompt: Use only these numeric coordinates, no image or object identification: TARGET T={"x": 652, "y": 318}; REFERENCE P={"x": 735, "y": 800}; both use x increasing right and y increasing down. Compare TARGET relative to REFERENCE. Output only vertical and horizontal relations.
